entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE standalone original raster game sprite of the USS SULACO from Aliens (1986), not a redesign. The last THREE images are anatomy/geometry references: 1 full studio miniature side silhouette (aft LEFT, bow RIGHT); 2 starboard middle hull details; 3 actual aft rectangular exhaust/plate assembly. Sources: https://modelermagic.com/sulaco-studio-model/ with fabrication corroboration https://www.johnleemodelmaker.me/aliens.aspx. Preserve the extremely long narrow industrial rifle-like hull, forward rounded box bulge, cluster of unequal thin forward antenna spars and one vertical bow mast, one dorsal turret, long side rail and underslung aft keel. Rear is a broad rounded housing with the DARK RECTANGULAR projecting plates in reference3, NOT round rocket engines. Match cool gray hull, panel division and relative masses of the reference. No extra fins/wings, no spaceship cockpit canopy, no invented four circular thrusters, no glow. Full vessel with ALL antennae and keel in frame, 10% margin, 1536x1024 landscape. Newly painted highly detailed bitmap suitable for menu compositing, restrained space light revealing the actual structure, crisp clean contour, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, opaque ship. No floor, cast shadow on backdrop, workshop/person/stand, photo borders, UI, text/nameplate/watermark. Exactly one ship and one camera view, not an atlas. CAMERA: bow-starboard three-quarter, moderately foreshortened: bow antennae nearest camera at lower RIGHT, aft recedes to upper LEFT. Camera 25 degrees ahead of true starboard side and 10 degrees above, so the bow's front face AND entire starboard side are visible. Preserve hull proportions in 3D; do not squash a side elevation or substitute an unrecognizable front-on fighter.
entries.reviewNote: Inscription SULACO integree : ne pas enregistrer comme Tantalus.
